nodes.label: Android SDK requirements
nodes.rationale: Minimum SDK 26; target and compile SDK 36 or newer stable requirements.

nodes.label: CameraX overlay requirement
nodes.rationale: The core tracing system overlays an image on a normal camera preview to support tracing on real paper; it is not 3D augmented reality.

nodes.label: Offline operation
nodes.rationale: Product rules require offline operation and exclude backend services, user accounts, network APIs, AI APIs, analytics, advertisements, subscriptions, and in-app purchases.

nodes.label: Simple architecture with stable AndroidX
nodes.rationale: Prefer stable AndroidX dependencies, avoid unnecessary complexity and rewrites, preserve configuration state, and support responsive edge-to-edge layouts.
